answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 15 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 340 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The pearl is the check that cannot be faked, the velvet is the price the attacker pays, and the spiral is the record that outlives the epoch.
